title: About Infimind
hero: Thoughtful Education. Personalised For Every Learner.
intro: Infimind believes every child learns differently. We design personalised learning journeys built around each learner through mentoring, academic guidance, wellbeing support and learning science.

sections.heading: Our Belief
sections.body: Education should adapt to the learner, not the learner to the system.

sections.heading: Our Approach
sections.body: Personal Mentor, Academic Counsellor and Health & Wellbeing Counsellor work together with continuous diagnostics and reviews.

sections.heading: Learning Science
sections.body: Evidence-informed methods guide every recommendation, review and learning plan.

sections.heading: Our Promise
sections.body: Every student receives attention, guidance and a personalised learning experience.
